title: agent-distro profile extension
description: The `extensions."asia.nixos.agent-distro"` member of a plugin.json: what the directory adds to the plugin itself when agent-distro reads it as a profile (src/profile/resolve.ts). Its members are the fields a profile carries. The plugin root is always the profile's first plugin and is never listed.

plugins.description: More Agent Plugins directories: a flake reference such as "github:owner/repo?dir=sub", or a path relative to the plugin root, which begins with "./".

packages.description: nixpkgs attribute paths ("mcp-nixos", "python3Packages.foo") put on PATH for every harness. They are fetched from the binary cache; a launch never compiles.

env.description: Variables every launch exports, and `{ "secret": true, "hint": "..." }` ones it prompts for when unset.

settings.description: What the harnesses that read it default. A non-empty `omp` also skips OMP's setup wizard.
